coverage.included: Response-level usage records in the explicitly supplied retained local session files whose root_turn_id matches.
coverage.excluded: Other local or account sessions, non-Codex usage, any response written after the source-file observation, and any absent or deleted local record.
coverage.cwd_limit: Selection requires the session's initial cwd to equal the project root; later directory changes and mixed-purpose sessions are not inferred.
coverage.cost_limit: No price or monetary cost is inferred. Local records contain token counters, not authoritative billing attribution.
coverage.privacy: Only allowlisted identifiers, timestamps, file metadata, model names and numeric counters are retained; conversation and tool contents are never emitted.
